nodes.title: ✏️ DESCRIPTION (couleurs + matières + lumière + pièces)
widgets_values: a bright open-plan Scandinavian kitchen that opens onto a cozy living room, light oak wood cabinets and open wooden shelves, warm cream and off-white walls, light oak wooden floor, white countertops, a kitchen island with wooden bar stools, black pendant lamps, green potted plants, a beige fabric sofa, a low wooden coffee table and a woven rug in the living area, large windows with soft warm morning daylight, warm neutral color palette, cozy natural atmosphere

widgets_values_named.value:
A seamless 360-degree equirectangular panorama, 2:1 aspect ratio, full spherical view shot from the exact center of a small modern Scandinavian bathroom, camera at 1.6 m height, level horizon, straight verticals, left and right edges connecting seamlessly.

Soft, diffuse natural daylight from a frosted window, gentle warm fill light, bright airy atmosphere, subtle soft shadows under floating furniture, realistic global illumination, high-end interior photography, photorealistic.

Walls: lower half covered with glossy sage-green vertical rectangular tiles in stacked bond with thin white grout; upper half glossy white vertical tiles with irregular sage-green vertical stripe accents of varying lengths, forming a playful graphic rhythm that continues around the whole room. Floor: large light warm-grey matte tiles. Ceiling: flat matte white with small recessed spotlights.

0° (front): floating blush-pink lacquered vanity with two wide drawers and slim horizontal handles, white stone countertop, sage-green round vessel basin, tall white matte mixer tap, round backlit LED mirror with a glowing ring, small amber glass soap dispenser, a cup with colorful toothbrushes. Above and beside it, a tall blush-pink wall cabinet with an open light-oak niche holding small toiletry bottles. Below, an open shelf with neatly folded striped towels in blue, yellow and pink.

90° (right): walk-in shower with a single frameless clear glass panel, matte white rainfall shower head on a curved arm, white hand shower on a slide rail, small integrated shelf, low-profile white shower tray. A pale pink bathrobe hanging on a wall hook next to the shower, a sage-green woven bath mat on the floor, a small blush-pink pedal bin.

180° (back): white interior door with a slim brushed-nickel handle, a white ladder towel radiator holding a folded pale-pink towel, a light-oak wall shelf with a small green plant and a woven basket.

270° (left): wall-hung white toilet with a flush plate, a frosted window with a white frame letting soft daylight in, a small potted plant on the windowsill.

Clean, tidy, lived-in feel, pastel palette of blush pink, sage green, white and light oak, crisp details, accurate proportions, no people, no text.

nodes.title: Mode d'emploi
widgets_values:
ENVIRONNEMENT v2 — PIPELINE INVERSÉ (360° d'abord)

1. DESCRIPTION : décris couleurs, matières, lumière ET toutes les zones de la pièce.
   C'est le seul canal vers l'étape 1.
2. ÉTAPE 1 : Qwen-Image-2512 + LoRA 360 -> structure de la pièce.
   Lance plusieurs seeds et garde la meilleure disposition AVANT la suite.
3. ÉTAPE 2 : Qwen-Edit restyle le 360° avec les moodboards (denoise 0.40).
   Picture 2 = moodboard 1 ; Picture 3 = moodboards 2 | 3 côte à côte.
   Structure qui bouge / couture cassée : 0.30. Style trop faible : 0.50.
4. ÉTAPE 3 : 4 découpes du 360° final, redressées (denoise 0.55).
   Vue A = plan HÉROS. Cohérence : les 4 vues viennent de la même sphère.
   Couture gauche/droite : entre les vues C et D (invisible dans les vues).

Moins de 3 moodboards : garde au minimum le 1 et adapte les prompts 2 et 3.
HDRI : sortie LDR. Blender : World = 360° final (force 1-2) + Sun lamp.
